name: nonApi_compilePermissionMatrix
description: Internal (no auth). Compiles the permission source tables (HC.PermissionFunction / HC.PermissionRole / HC.RolePermission) into the JSON projections the clients read — the ONLY writer of those projections (the compile-on-save invariant, Permissions V2). Global matrix -> HC.ServerStatus.PermissionMatrixJson ({schemaVersion:1, version:<ISO now>, functions:[{key, areaKey, surfaces, mmMask, flagMask, hareScoped}]}) and bumps ServerStatus.PermissionMatrixUpdatedAt. Per-kennel override -> HC.Kennel.PermissionOverrideJson ({schemaVersion:1, functions:[{key, mmMask, flagMask, hareScoped}]}) for every kennel that has HC.RolePermission rows, resolving the tri-state server-side (kennel Allowed 1 = grant, -1 = revoke, 0 / no row = inherit global); cleared to NULL for kennels whose override rows are all gone. Called by HC6.hcportal_savePermissionMatrix after every save and by the archived permission migrations.

parameters.name: kennelId
parameters.description: NULL (default) = recompile the global matrix AND every kennel with override rows; a value = the global matrix AND just that kennel's override.

sideEffects: UPDATE HC.ServerStatus SET PermissionMatrixJson, PermissionMatrixUpdatedAt (no WHERE — the table holds one row).

UPDATE HC.Kennel SET PermissionOverrideJson for kennels with HC.RolePermission rows (fires the Kennel updatedAt trigger, so those kennels re-sync to every phone — the user sync's Kennels rowset carries permissionOverrideJson).
UPDATE HC.Kennel SET PermissionOverrideJson = NULL where it is set but no override rows remain.
All in one transaction; the CATCH rolls back, INSERTs HC.ErrorLog ('<unknown>') and THROWs.

codeSmells.detail: Line 58 updates every row of HC.ServerStatus. The table is single-row by convention, so this is fine today, but a second row would receive the matrix too.

breakingChangeRules: Never remove a column from any rowset
Never change a sentinel value meaning
Never change errorType integer codes without updating all callers
